verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a product platform like PostHog, so the axis applies. The pack shows no recurring scheduler or workflow automation. The only scheduling evidence is "schedule changes" for feature flags, which is a one-off timed flag change, not a recurring schedule. The batch-export mention gives no scheduling cadence, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
